_note: Structured course data for the 2026-2027 academic year, reconciled across the three presentations on pharosacademy.net (/daily-course-offerings, /full-course-descriptions, /courses-by-grade-level) and their PDF equivalents. Captured 2026-07-28. Disagreements between sources are recorded in the `conflicts` field on the affected course and summarised in ../README.md.

rateCard.note: Every published cost is internally consistent with an hourly rate times contact hours. Two rates are in use.

feesNotInCourseData.source: policy-handbook.pdf (updated 2026-07-23) and the Apply Now Google Form
feesNotInCourseData.registrationFee: $25 per student per year, non-refundable. The Google Form calls the same $25 an 'application fee' payable by cheque mailed to the school.
feesNotInCourseData.studyHall: $60 per student per study hall; handbook also states '$10 per study hall' in the payment section — the two figures disagree
feesNotInCourseData.classFeeSchedule: Quarterly: Aug 24, Oct 12 (week 6), Dec 7 (week 13), Feb 8 (week 19). $50 per class late fee.
feesNotInCourseData.tuitionCollection: Handbook: 'Pay any remaining tuition to instructors by the deadline.' Tuition is currently NOT collected centrally by the school.
